integrity: The formula has an explicit proof; finite checks cover ten instances and do not establish the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Radical-square-zero path algebras of finite quivers, counting unit-conjugacy classes of commuting tuples. Does not extend to radical-cube-zero. Independent mathematical verification and complete priority review unavailable.
title: A random-cluster formula for all-arity commuting-tuple orbits in radical-square-zero quiver algebras
